sanskrit: yan no agnir asanad yan na indro viśve yad devā marutaḥ svarkāḥ | tad asmabhyaṃ savitā satyadharmā sarasvaty anumatir ni yacchāt ||
english: Whatever Agni has granted us, whatever Indra, whatever all the gods, the Maruts bright with light — may Savitā of true ordinance, Sarasvatī, and Anumati bestow that upon us.

sanskrit: yūyaṃ no devā ubhayāya vedase śarma yacchata dvipade catuṣpade | adat pibad ūrjayamānam āśitaṃ tad asmabhyaṃ śaṃ yor arapo dadhāta ||
english: O gods, for the sake of both kinds of welfare, grant shelter to our two-footed and four-footed creatures. One who eats, who drinks, who is nourished with strength and is well-fed — establish for us that state of well-being and ease, free from affliction.

sanskrit: bṛhaspate savitar bodhayainaṃ saṃśitaṃ cit saṃtaraṃ saṃ śiśādhi | vardhayainaṃ mahate saubhagāya viśva enam anu madanti devāḥ ||
english: O Bṛhaspati, O Savitā, awaken him; though already sharpened, whet him yet more keenly. Make him grow for great good fortune; may all the gods rejoice after him.

sanskrit: amutrabhūyād adhi yad yamasya bṛhaspatir abhiśastyā amuñcata | prati mṛtyum auhatām aśvinā te devānām agne bhiṣajā śacībhiḥ ||
english: May he thrive yonder beyond what Yama holds; Bṛhaspati has released him from the accusation. May those two Aśvins, the healers of the gods, push back death from him, O Agni, with their skills.

sanskrit: indrāvaruṇā sutapāv imaṃ sutaṃ madyaṃ somaṃ pibataṃ dhṛtavratā | yuvo ratho adhvaraṃ devavītaye prati svasaram upa yāti pītaye ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, you two who are drinkers of the pressed, drink this pressed, intoxicating soma, you who hold firm to your vows. Your chariot comes to the rite for the delight of the gods, comes at daybreak for the drinking.

sanskrit: indrāvaruṇā madhumattamasya vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām | idaṃ vām asme pariṣiktam andha āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayethām ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, you two bulls, drink your fill of the most sweetly intoxicating, vigorous soma. This drink has been poured out for you two among us; be seated on this sacred grass and be exhilarated.

sanskrit: uru viṣṇo vi kramasv- -oru kṣayāya niṣ kṛdhi | ghṛtaṃ ghṛtayone piba pra pra yajñapatiṃ tira ||
english: Step wide, O Viṣṇu; make a broad dwelling space. Drink the ghee, O you born from ghee; lead forward, forward the lord of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: divo viṣṇa uta vā pṛthivyā uror vā viṣṇo maho antarikṣāt | ubhā hi hastau madhunā pṛṇasv- -āprayaccha dakṣiṇād ota savyāt ||
english: From the sky, O Viṣṇu, or from the earth, or from the wide, great middle-space — fill both your hands with sweetness; reach them out, from the right and from the left.

sanskrit: viṣṇor nū kaṃ pra vocaṃ vīryāṇi yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṃsi | yo askabhāyad uttaraṃ sadhasthaṃ vicakramāṇas tredhorugāyaḥ ||
english: Now let me proclaim the heroic deeds of Viṣṇu, who measured out the earthly realms, who propped up the upper abode as he strode forth — the wide-pacing one who strides in three ways.

sanskrit: pra tad viṣṇu stavate vīryāṇi mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ | yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣv adhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā ||
english: Viṣṇu proclaims those heroic deeds: like a fearsome wild beast that roams and dwells on the mountains — in whose three wide strides all the worlds abide.

sanskrit: agnāviṣṇū mahi dhāma priyaṃ vāṃ pātaṃ ghṛtasya guhyāni nāma | damedame sapta ratnā dadhān- -opa vāṃ jihvā ghṛtam ā caraṇyāt ||
english: O Agni and Viṣṇu, great is your dear abode; guard the secret names of ghee. Bearing the seven treasures in house after house, may the tongue move toward you laden with ghee.

sanskrit: agnāviṣṇū mahi tad vāṃ mahitvaṃ vītaṃ ghṛtasya guhyā juṣāṇā | damedame suṣṭutyā vāvṛdhānā prati vāṃ jihvā ghṛtam uc caraṇyāt ||
english: O Agni and Viṣṇu, great is that greatness of yours; enjoy the secret gifts of ghee. Growing with excellent praise in house after house, may the tongue rise up to you with ghee.

sanskrit: un nambhaya pṛthivīṃ bhindhīdaṃ divyaṃ nabhaḥ | ūdhno divyasya no dhātar īśāno vi ṣyā bilam ||
english: Raise up the earth; pierce open this heavenly cloud. O Dhātṛ, lord and sovereign of the heavenly udder, open wide the aperture for us.

sanskrit: apakrāman pauruṣeyād gṛṇāno daivyaṃ sahaḥ | praṇītīr abhyāvartasva devo devānāṃ sakhyā juṣāṇaḥ ||
english: Moving away from the human realm, praising the divine might — turn back toward our leadings, O god, enjoying the friendship of the gods.

sanskrit: pitor ahaṃ pitupatiṃ tad īḍe dhātā vidhartā bhuvaneṣv eṣu | nemena mahyaṃ madhumām̐ ihaidhi nemenāmuṣmai viṣuvān nv edhi ||
english: I worship the lord of nourishment through nourishment — Dhātṛ, the ordainer, in these worlds. By the half-measure be sweet for me here; by the half-measure be the equator now for that one yonder.

sanskrit: ayaṃ pitoḥ pitumān ābhṛtas par- -īdaṃ śṛṇotu yad ahaṃ bravīmi | nemena mahyaṃ madhumām̐ ihaidhi nemenāmuṣmai viṣuvān nv edhi ||
english: This nourishing one has been brought with nourishment beyond; let this one hear what I say. By the half-measure be sweet for me here; by the half-measure be the equator now for that one yonder.

sanskrit: atraivainaṃ nirṛta ā rabhasv- -ātraivainaṃ nirṛte pra kṣiṇīhy atraivainaṃ sarva vi vṛśca | nemena mahyaṃ madhumām̐ ihaidhi nemenāmuṣmai viṣuvān nv edhi ||
english: Here seize him, O Nirṛti; here destroy him, O Nirṛti; here cut him entirely away. By the half-measure be sweet for me here; by the half-measure be the equator now for that one yonder.

sanskrit: yat tvā pita upabruve tan ma ā śṛṇv asmin me have havyo yathāsaḥ | amuṃ devair nirṛtiḥ saṃvidān- -āmuṃ chinatti varuṇasya pāśāt ||
english: Whatever I invoke of you, O Nourishment, hear that for me; be one to be invoked in this call of mine. Nirṛti, conspiring together with the gods, severs that one yonder from the snare of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: yad asmṛti cakṛmā kiṃ cid ena upārima caraṇair jātavedaḥ | tasmāt pāhi tvaṃ naḥ pracetaḥ śubhe sakhibhyo amṛtatvam asmān ||
english: Whatever sin we have committed through forgetfulness, whatever we have come upon with our steps, O Jātavedas — from that protect us, O wise one, for good fortune; lead us and our friends to immortality.

sanskrit: agne 'dhyakṣo na ehi pāhi no duritāt pāhi duṣvapnyāt | āsanyād anyād yakṣmān naḥ pāhi ||
english: O Agni, overseer, come to us; protect us from misfortune, protect us from evil dreams. Protect us from disease of the mouth and from all other afflictions.

sanskrit: tviṣir asi tviṣivanto bhūyāsma | cakṣuṣmanto gomantaḥ prajāvanto varcasvinaḥ ||
english: You are radiance; may we become full of radiance — possessed of vision, rich in cattle, rich in progeny, and full of splendor.

sanskrit: yad ahnā saṃcinutha kṣīraṃ bharathodhabhiḥ | idaṃ tad viśvarūpā vaḥ payo harāmi vīrudhā ||
english: The milk you collect by day, the milk you carry in your udders — that milk of yours, O all-formed ones, I take away with a herb.

sanskrit: yad aghnyā oṣadhībhyo 'dbhyaḥ saṃbharathā madhu | idaṃ tad viśvarūpā vaḥ kṣīraṃ harāmy oṣadhyā ||
english: The sweetness you cows gather from herbs, from waters — that milk of yours, O all-formed ones, I take away with a plant.

sanskrit: yo abhyavabhṛṇāyasi svapantam iccha pūruṣaṃ śayānam akasvalam | ayasmayena varmaṇ- -āśmamayena varmaṇā pary asmān varuṇo dadhat ||
english: You who press down upon one — seek out a sleeping man, one who lies there listless. May Varuṇa enfold us with armor of iron, with armor of stone.

sanskrit: ye no gṛhe brāhmaṇā manyamānā ghorāṃ vācaṃ mithuyānubruvanti | enohṛto malahṛto bhavantu duryoṇam asmat pari te harantu ||
english: Those who, considering themselves Brahmins in our house, speak cruel words falsely — may they become laden with sin, laden with filth; may they carry away from us the evil dwelling.

sanskrit: ayam agniḥ satpatir vṛddhavṛṣṇiyo rathīva patyai na janayat purohitaḥ | nābhā pṛthivyā nihito davidyutad adhaspadaṃ kṛṇutāṃ ye pṛtanyavaḥ ||
english: This Agni, lord of truth, of ancient virile strength, like a charioteer has generated for the lord as his domestic priest. Placed at the navel of the earth, blazing forth — may those who fight against us be trampled underfoot.

sanskrit: agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnāny uttamāni santu | saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamam ā kṛṇuṣva śatrūyatām abhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi ||
english: O Agni, roar out for great good fortune; let your glories be the highest. Bring together a well-ordered household; advance against the great powers of those who act as enemies.

sanskrit: dṛṣṭo damūnā atithir duroṇa imaṃ no yajñam upa yāhi vidvān | viśvā hy agne abhiyujo vihatya śatrūyatām ā bharā bhojanāni ||
english: You have been seen, O lord of the house, as the guest in the hall; come to this sacrifice of ours, O knowing one. For, O Agni, having struck down all attackers, bring the riches of those who act as enemies.

sanskrit: agne sapatnān pra ṇudasva jātān praty ajātāñ jātavedo nudasva | adhi no brūhi sumanasyamānaḥ śarma no yaccha trivarūtham udbhit ||
english: O Agni, drive away our rivals who have been born; O Jātavedas, drive back those not yet born. Speak on our behalf with benevolence; grant us shelter, the three-folded protection that bursts forth.

sanskrit: prānyān sapatnān sahasā sahasva praty ajātāñ jātavedaḥ śṛṇīhi | idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pipṛhi saubhagāy- -ānu tvā devā vasavo madantām ||
english: Overpower the other rivals with might; O Jātavedas, strike down those not yet born. Fill this realm for good fortune; may the Vasus, the gods, rejoice following you.
